failure_modes.recovery: Status moves are transitions: call expense_submit / expense_approve / expense_reject / expense_reimburse.
failure_modes.when: the payload tries to write status or an approval stamp

failure_modes.recovery: Re-read the expense, merge, retry with the fresh updated_at.
failure_modes.when: expected_updated_at was passed and another writer changed the row first

preconditions: id is required. Only field edits here — never status moves.

description: Edits an expense's own fields only — status and approval stamps refuse with VALIDATION_ERROR here since those are transitions (expense_submit, expense_approve, expense_reject, expense_reimburse). amount_cents, if changed, must stay integer CENTS. Only the expense's own creator may edit it, and content freezes once the row is 'pending', reimbursed, or approved by someone else — draft, rejected, and your own self-approved rows stay editable.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at you last read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT with the current value.

name: expense_update
